model.name: TVD-FV plus jump-gated conservative DKAN subcells

benchmark.note: None of these amplitudes was used in sensor design or earlier amplitude scans. The target sine family and viscosity 0.001 were absent from pretraining.

primary_metric.definition: fixed-MC normalized L2 divided by gated-DKAN normalized L2
primary_metric.aggregate: geometric mean over all 12 parameter cases per seed, followed by median over five seeds
primary_metric.success: median aggregate gain >= 1.20 and bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound > 1.00

secondary_gates.per_case_no_material_degradation: gated L2 <= 1.05 * fixed-MC L2 for every seed-case pair

claim_boundary: Passing this protocol supports only the Burgers subcell branch. It does not establish the overall DKAN+PINN 20% claim without Euler and the final ten-seed float64 protocol.

outcome.evidence: At amplitude 0.65, gated-DKAN L2 was 26.45% worse than fixed MC for nu=0 and 30.00% worse for nu=0.001.
outcome.diagnosis: Fixed MC exceeded initial profile TV by 0.46% and 0.68%, respectively. Enforcing an exact initial-TV cap removed that excess but caused the accuracy loss.
